Sort rows in a MTD matrix to match the expected order

Source: R/MTD.R
mtdSort.Rd

Helper function to sort a mzTab-M MTD matrix, such as generated by mtdSkeleton(), into the correct order of the metadata fields.

Usage

mtdSort(x)

Arguments

x

two-column matrix with the first column containing the metadata field names.

Value

input parameter x sorted into the correct order.

See also

MTD-export for other functions defining metadata information

Author

Johannes Rainer

Examples


## Minimal MTD section
mtd <- mtdSkeleton(id = "001", software = "[MS, MS:1001582, xmcs, 4.0.0]")

mtdSort(mtd)
